- Dialogs (Material and AMOLED): the "i" sign above every dialog is gone (more room); a warning keeps its sign.
- Buttons: the icon a button was given now shows in the Material and AMOLED looks too (it was left out).
- Video player: every menu and dialog is pure black, its buttons, fields and chips are a thin edge on black (no grey fills); icons on Source, Look, Timing, Upright, Sideways, Small window, Bold, Outline, Background, File, Search, Close, OK, Reset delay, and the language row.
- Mini players (the video player's and YouTube's): a throw keeps the window moving with the finger's speed and slows it down by friction (momentum), it no longer jumps to a side; the speed of the video window is measured right (it was read inside the moving window and came out near zero).
- Video mini player: the close target at the bottom is smaller; the subtitle file picked in the player goes on in the small window; opening another video closes the one in the small window (one video at a time).
- Books: the Project Gutenberg line under the search is gone; searching, the classics, the categories and a download show a moving bar instead of the word Loading.
- Game Hub CD shelf: the disc prints the game's wide art (or a screenshot) and the booklet inside the case opens on its screenshots, with the wide art on its back (inside and out were the same cover).
- Search fields: an × empties the field.
- Game Hub settings: every setting is a full row with its icon, name and value; Shelf, Case style, Tile size, View, Icons and Start page open a list of radio choices (no rows of pills); the colour look is called Colours and its dark shelf is no longer named "Boxshelf (default)" (the CD shelf is the default shelf).
- Game Hub CD shelf: the Select games list and Add an HTML game buttons (Boxshelf had them only) are on the CD shelf too, at the top right.
- Game Hub CD shelf: while a case is out (Inspect), the search field and the round search / add buttons step aside.
- Video speed: the usual speeds (0.5x to 2x) are a row of their own and "Keep for the next videos" is a row under them (it lay over them).
- Video notification: a video with no cover gets a frame of itself as its picture, the media card is told the video's length (its bar runs), and the notification shows where the video is and how long it is.
- Video (Android 16): a live update beside the media card: the video's picture and name, where it is as a bar, and the time left in the status bar chip; play / pause on it.
- Motion cues tile: its own round icon again (it pulses on a tap; the drawing of a phone with dots is gone).
- Auto clicker and Floating timer tiles: their icons sit in the middle of the tile, and each has a tap animation (the arrow moves in and clicks, the hourglass turns over).
- Video: Back is predictive: while the back gesture is held the video shrinks toward where the mini player opens (and grows back if the gesture is called off).
